lead: Date picking: the trigger reuses Select's look, the popup reuses Popover with a [Calendar](/calendar) inside. A single pick closes the popup as soon as a date is chosen; a range closes once the end date is picked.

time.title: Date and time
time.description: `showTime` adds a time panel next to the calendar (single selection only), and the value becomes "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm". Changing the date keeps the time; picking a time before a date uses today's date. The popup closes on **OK** or a click outside.

picker.title: Week, month, quarter, year
picker.description: `picker` sets the granularity. The month / quarter / year panels are PeriodCalendar (also usable on its own); the week one is Calendar's `mode="week"`.

editable.title: Editable
editable.description: `editable` turns the trigger into an input where you type the date in a fixed format. It is checked and committed on Enter or blur: invalid text is marked invalid after Enter and restored on blur. The Down key or the calendar icon opens the popup, and a date picked there is copied into the input.

in-field.title: In Field
in-field.description: Inside a [Field](/field), it takes the Field's `variant` / `size` and its disabled / invalid state, unless passed on the DatePicker.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: DatePicker has no CSS file of its own: the trigger comes from `select.css`, the popup from `popover.css`, the calendar from `calendar.css`.
styling.popup: The popup, reusing Popover's slots; `data-picker` lets theme styles drop the popup's own padding
styling.calendar: The Calendar in the popup, see the [Calendar](/calendar) page
